question_text: A government employee is randomly selected for a mandatory drug test under RA 9165 (Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002). The employee refuses to submit, claiming it violates his right to privacy. Which of the following best describes the legality of the mandatory drug test?

options.text: The drug test is illegal because it violates the employee's right to privacy under the Constitution.
The drug test is legal because RA 9165 mandates drug testing for government employees as a reasonable requirement for public service.
The drug test is legal only if the employee is suspected of drug use.
The drug test is illegal because it requires a court order.
